problem: Article detail page does not render body content even though API returns contentHtml

evidence.payloadShape: Vue SFC: HTML comments + <template>...</template> + <script setup> with Vue directives (@click, :class, {{ currentCodeSnippet }})

rootCause: HTML5 <template> is inert: children live in a DocumentFragment and are not painted. v-html = innerHTML, so the whole article body is invisible. <script> via innerHTML also does not run, so tabs/copy/interpolations cannot work.
secondary: Vue directives and mustaches are inert inside v-html
Font Awesome classes in payload are not loaded in index.html
Tailwind JIT will not generate utility classes that exist only in CMS HTML
